cluster_stories.title: ChatGPT, Reddit (RDDT), Roblox (RBLX) Face EU Digital Services Act Rules
cluster_stories.summary: ChatGPT, Reddit Inc. and video game company Roblox Corp. will face stricter European Union scrutiny after surpassing a threshold of 45 million monthly users in the bloc.
cluster_stories.headline: CHATGPT, REDDIT, ROBLOX HIT WITH EU DIGITAL RULES

cluster_stories.title: ChatGPT becomes the first AI chatbot designated under the DSA
cluster_stories.summary: The European Commission has classified ChatGPT as a search engine. Monday’s designation brings the chatbot under the Digital Services Act as a Very Large Online Search Engine, alongside Reddit and Roblox, which have been designated as Very Large Online Platforms. ChatGPT is the first AI chatbot to be designated under the regime. The Commission announced […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: CHATGPT DESIGNATED AS SEARCH ENGINE UNDER EU'S DSA

cluster_stories.title: US to press G20 on light-touch AI regulation
cluster_stories.summary: Tech bosses including Elon Musk, Nvidia's Jensen Huang and OpenAI's Sam Altman are participating in a G20 meeting in North Carolina this week amid a global debate on how governments should address the dangers of artificial intelligence. The meeting is spread over two days, with Musk joining by video call on Tuesday, and Huang and Altman expected in person on Wednesday for fireside chats with Lutnick.
cluster_stories.headline: US PUSHES G20 for Light-Touch AI Regulation

cluster_stories.title: Europe has ordered a €388M AI supercomputer from its own state-owned champion

LUMI-AI is a €387.8 million system, roughly $449 million, that will be built by Bull, the French supercomputer maker that the French state bought outright five months ago. cluster_stories.headline: EU Orders €388M AI Supercomputer From State Champion Bull
